evidence.observation: The README, Surface, package tree, and local indexes expose five operational owners and distinguish product contract, generated views, historical audits, and executable code.
evidence.excerpt: Lattice is a local-first conversational lattice harness: a user progressively authors a graph of model invocations, one consequential edge at a time

evidence.observation: Typed direct and role-session actors, stateless assemblies, route-specific batch members, confirmation hashes, and receipts model conversation as the kernel primitive while workflows remain an optional governed layer.

The same-origin REST boundary carries typed batch preview, atomic create, episodes, navigation, context modules, exact slices, and compatibility endpoints without exposing an alternate graph authority.
An implementation boundary separate from the compositor recomputes generated identity, source bindings, actor semantics, segment lineage, omission states, and exact provider bytes.
evidence.excerpt: Verify a durable manifest or a stateless batch candidate independently.

evidence.observation: Foreground graph reads use bounded pagination and explicit limits while large payloads remain in the content-addressed blob store; the audit found no claimed hard realtime budget or numeric hot loop.
evidence.excerpt: ORDER BY created_at DESC,invocation_id DESC LIMIT ?

evidence.observation: Snapshot creation refuses active work and symlinked sources, copies SQLite consistently, binds the captured generation, inventories every file, and restores through a verified staging root.
evidence.excerpt: Publish one complete snapshot only after its database and file inventory verify.

evidence.observation: Batch idempotency, preview compare-and-swap, all-or-none sealing, append events, and route-specific manifests share one SQLite transaction; execution leases and retries remain separate immutable attempts.
evidence.excerpt: Persist every sealed invocation in one transaction before any provider attempt can begin.

evidence.observation: Loopback host checks, same-origin operator sessions, CSRF, mode-0600 CLI capability, security headers, and no-CORS defaults constrain local mutations and iframe authority.
Doctor-readable diagnostics distinguish service, schema, append-chain, blob, journal, workflow, provider, runtime, backup, and active-work states without aliasing a failed dependency to empty data.
The public CLI exposes serve, open, status, doctor, backup, and restore with structured JSON modes and actionable nonzero failure exits while Outport remains service authority.

Installation builds a non-editable versioned runtime, verifies its full manifest, publishes selectors and launchd jobs transactionally, probes the exact runtime generation, and rolls back a failed publication.

owner_sources.excerpt: Real personal data is not imported automatically. Closure means the system has survived synthetic, sanitized, authenticated-provider, restart, and restore testing and is ready for the user to begin real-data operation.

prior_art.description: The retrieved Lattice product contract compares linear chat, visual workflows, durable runners, Dandelion, Loom, and agent session managers by node scale and progressive graph authorship.

mechanisms.mechanism: The design adapts graph branching and session control but keeps the next conversational edge, not a predefined workflow or whole job, as the human-authored primitive.

prior_art.description: The product contract separates Smithers-scale job recovery and model-runner execution durability from Lattice-owned prompt, topology, and context semantics.

mechanisms.mechanism: Lattice reuses immutable journals, leases, and resumability below the graph while refusing to make job or provider sessions the canonical conversation identity.

findings.title: The supervised service does not run the audited conversation-first generation
findings.claim: The operator-visible launchd service is healthy but its installed runtime manifest binds Lattice source 5fce638f, while this audit binds f4d70ba; the remediated cockpit and kernel are therefore not yet the running product.
findings.failure_mode: Opening Lattice through its authoritative Outport identity executes an older verified package and cannot exercise the audited direct-conversation, context-action, and secondary-failure changes.
findings.consequence: Real personal operation would validate and depend on a different object from the one this remediation and audit describe, so real-data-ready closure would be materially false even though data integrity and rollback remain healthy.
findings.response: Publish this or a later clean immutable revision through the staged installer, require doctor to bind the selected source revision, and repeat the exact-current browser and authenticated acceptance paths before admitting personal data.

adversarial_passes.scope: Pre-existing independent readers, deterministic fixtures, browser interception, restore inventory, and doctor probes attack the producer's conversation and recovery claims.

mutations.statement: Secretly require or inject a role into a direct invocation.
mutations.oracle: The direct-actor kernel oracle rejects a role session on a direct actor and reconstructs no role bytes.

mutations.statement: Submit one idempotency key twice and create duplicate invocations.
mutations.oracle: The batch receipt and event-count oracle require exactly one semantic creation.

mutations.statement: Delete one referenced blob and report restore success.
mutations.oracle: Snapshot assessment rejects a readable database whose content inventory is incomplete.

mutations.statement: Serve a runtime generation different from the selected and Outport-bound generation.
mutations.oracle: Doctor and live-publication tests reject the prior or mismatched runtime.

mutations.statement: Make an optional graph or workflow request failure erase the selected response.
mutations.oracle: The browser-negative regression retains response and composer while rendering the planted secondary failure.

closure_claims.statement: The synthetic source generation rejects the named actor, idempotency, restore, runtime-disagreement, and secondary-surface mutations while preserving prior workflow and import contracts.

residuals.statement: No successful authenticated Claude/Codex acceptance report binds the exact audited source revision after three bounded attempts.

The complete mocked browser path passed before secondary-failure isolation and the current negative mutation passed afterward, but the corrected exact-current full path was not rerun after its fixture defect.

This audit used validator, independent reader, and negative-control code paths but was produced in the same implementation session; no separate human or agent reviewer has verified the immutable revision.
The host lacks the Go toolchain, so Outport's own repository suite was not rerun; Lattice's consumption and disagreement contracts passed independently.
